0022600019.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-1, 2-0 at home, 3-1 in their last ten) host the Orlando Magic (1-3, 0-2 at home, 1-3 in their last ten) in the fifth game of Toronto's season and an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup, with the Raptors third in the East and half a game back in the Atlantic while the Magic sit 11th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Southeast. Toronto is on a one-game winning streak, and the Raptors lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after beating Orlando 129-99 in Toronto on October 28, 2026, following a 2-1 Raptors series win in 2025-26. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain).
